title: Massive MSFS Marketplace Update: New City Landscapes & Regional Airline Hub!
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator marketplace just received a massive urban injection, shifting the focus from standard high-altitude flight lines to incredibly dense, handcrafted city skylines. Whether you want to fly low over the iconic bridges of North America or explore the famous coastlines of South America, this week's drop is an absolute treat for VFR and helicopter pilots.

In this video, we dive into a huge wave of custom landmarks packages from DFFLYERDIRECT covering massive metropolitan hubs like Montreal and Rio de Janeiro, alongside New Orleans and San Antonio. We also check out a brand-new European regional hub in Belgium: Brussels South Charleroi Airport (EBCI) by Propair Flight, perfect for tight airline turnarounds and short-haul low-cost carrier operations.

Are you sticking to the airport tarmac in Belgium for realistic airliner turnarounds, or are you picking up one of those new city packs to practice your low-altitude helicopter and sightseeing runs? Let me know your top picks in the comments below!

If this quick breakdown helped you plan your next flight route, make sure to smash that like button and subscribe for more flight sim updates every week.
